title: SWITCH project: Definition of treat-to-target criteria for shared decision making between patients and physicians about initiating, continuing or switching systemic treatment for chronic prurigo and chronic pruritus
summary: The aim of this study is to define, validate and harmonize among experts criteria for treatment in adult patients with mild, moderate to severe chronic prurigo, including prurigo nodularis.

interventions.name:
Part 1: 
150 subjects at the coordinating center in Münster, Germany
(visit and filling in questionnaires)
Part 2: 
100 patients in external centers
(visit and filling in questionnaires)

Part 3: 
150 patients with chronic pruritus at the coordinating center in Münster, Germany

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with chronic prurigo
and in Part 3: chronic pruritus
Exclusion criteria:
Limitations in the understanding of the German language
